wikitext: {{Unknown name}} {{Incomplete}} {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Kiawe's family's ranch |image=Paniola Ranch anime.png |characters= |japanese= |region=Alola |colorscheme=Alola |epicode=SM011 |episode=Young Kiawe Had a Farm! }} '''Kiawe's family's ranch''' is a [[Moomoo Milk]] dairy farm on [[Akala Island]] in the [[Alola]] [[region]], where {{an|Kiawe}} and his family live and work. It is located close to [[Wela Volcano Park]], and its fertile volcanic soil helps to raise the ranch's grazing Pokémon. The ranch first appeared in ''[[SM011|Young Kiawe Had a Farm!]]'', where {{Ash}} visited it and helped Kiawe out with some farm chores. While Kiawe's father, [[Rango]], is the president of the farm, Kiawe is very much involved with the facilities upkeep. Kiawe uses his {{TP|Kiawe|Charizard}} to air deliver the Moomoo Milk products every morning, including cheeses and ice creams, to customers and restaurants across Alola including [[Aina's Kitchen]]. The ranch prides itself on its quality and freshness. In ''[[SM030|The Ol' Raise and Switch!]]'', Kiawe took [[Lana's Popplio]] to his ranch as part of a school project, where his class temporarily traded their partners. Although Kiawe at first had trouble figuring out what to do with Popplio, it eventually proved its usefulness by calming down a pair of fighting {{p|Tauros}}. The ranch reappeared in ''[[SM033|Big Sky, Small Fry!]]'', where Kiawe alongside {{an|Mallow}}, {{an|Sophocles}}, and {{an|Lillie}}, who wanted to try out its various Moomoo Milk products, including cheese and ice cream, during a class excursion to Akala Island. The ranch appeared again in ''[[SM070|The Young Flame Strikes Back!]]'', when businessman [[Viren]] attempted to buy the ranch from Kiawe and his family to construct his own resort hotel, but was declined. Viren then commanded [[Viren's henchmen|his henchmen]] to harass the family, and resorted to stopping the farm's water supply in a bid to obtain the farm. Eventually they were arrested and charged by [[Officer Jenny]] for forging land owner documents, trespassing, and malicious destruction to property. In [[SM103]], when Ash and {{ashcl}} visited the ranch as a part of {{an|Brock}} and {{an|Misty}} sightseeing tour of the Alola region. Brock was immediately impressed by the ranch's facilities, and took a tour of its stables and pens.
